new_entries.title: Face-level image index of the Lipi CISI crops and dimension units audit (13 October 2026)

rights.detail: Own work (CC0 prose and aggregates, Unlicense code) except the dimension table, mismatch lists and split detail, which carry record-level Lipi size values (no licence at the pin) and stay outside the CC0 dedication; images, OCR text and page renders are local only.

steps: Hold the Lipi export at fc8813a, the older website export at 2434249, CISI 1 and CISI 2 scans, and the October 12 split.
python -P experiments/2026-10-13-image-index-and-units/page_index.py --out <new run>/pages; build_index.py --out <new run>/images; dimensions.py --out <new run>/dimensions

changed_entries.text: 23 crop file names name the wrong object and 8 write I for l in the prefix (corrected in experiments/2026-10-13-image-index-and-units/name-overrides.tsv); fields h, v, th hold each size as recorded in inches, millimetres or centimetres
